record.field: Can clear Gate Passes waiting at security (approve to Posted or reject), mark vehicles Gate In / Gate Out, and see the Vehicles Inside dashboard. Cannot edit product/quantity lines once a pass leaves Draft.

Full control: sees every Active Company's Gate Passes regardless of the per-user restriction, can approve edit requests, reset a posted/rejected Gate Pass back to Draft, and force-close an RGP return without a matching Return Gate Pass (data-correction only — the normal return path is "Return Items").
